rejected_grains.name: SINGLE_TERMINAL_SURVIVAL_ROW

identity_policy.mng_no_role: bounded continuity/linkage candidate only; every build must fail closed if the expected uniqueness invariant is violated

episode_semantics.episode_partition_basis: observed source status state, not business-name/address similarity
episode_semantics.sparse_transition_boundaries: interval-censored between the last observation of the previous state and the first observation of the next state

hard_rules_for_next_phase: canonical schema must keep permit identity separate from establishment identity
no row may be merged across permits solely from business name, address or coordinates
status 03 must not create an irreversible terminal survival label
episode boundaries must preserve interval censoring unless directly bracketed by dated observations
status code 05 must remain unmapped until its semantics are verified
production episode reconstruction remains disabled until an explicit bounded history-observation strategy is approved

next_gate.goal: freeze PERMIT_STATUS_EPISODE columns next without resolving establishment identity or inventing terminal closure semantics
